title: Chicken, cauliflower and swede barley pot

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple; chicken stock, crème fraîche and wholegrain mustard are all acceptable.

supermarket.reason: Chicken thighs, swede, cauliflower, pearl barley and the rest are everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and a wooden spoon, and the technique is simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: 250g barley in 1.2 litres of stock for about 45 minutes, covered, cooks through with sensible liquid; eight thighs plus a whole cauliflower and swede feed four, and mustard, thyme and crème fraîche season it well.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers peeling and dicing a small swede, slicing onions, cutting florets and the 10 minutes of browning and softening, and the 45 minutes of cook time matches the two simmers.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including thyme, is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming barley and root vegetable pot suits a cold 31 December, and a whole cauliflower is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, wholegrain barley and two vegetables make a filling, balanced family dinner.
